unit_of_observation: one fictional student in the tutoring encouragement experiment
exposure_mechanism: exactly 1,500 students are randomly assigned a tutoring encouragement and 1,500 are assigned no encouragement; tutoring receipt remains incomplete in both groups
target_estimand: complier average effect of receiving tutoring for students whose receipt is changed by randomized encouragement, under relevance, independence, exclusion, and monotonicity
warning: This simulation is not a validated model of tutoring or student behavior. Random encouragement identifies its assignment effect; the Wald receipt effect additionally requires exclusion and monotonicity and is not automatically the population ATE.
causal_structure: random encouragement can change tutoring receipt
principal stratum determines whether receipt responds to encouragement
tutoring receipt affects the end-term mathematics outcome
encouragement has no direct outcome effect in the generator

structural_equations.encouragement_assignment: exactly half assigned 1 after a deterministic-seed shuffle
structural_equations.tutoring_received: 1 for always-takers; equals encouragement_assignment for compliers; 0 for never-takers

missing_value_code: none; all five fields are complete

variables.name: encouragement_assignment
variables.role: randomized instrumental variable and assignment exposure

variables.name: tutoring_received
variables.time: after encouragement and before the outcome

variables.name: end_term_math_score
variables.time: end of term after tutoring receipt

latent_variables_not_in_csv: principal stratum: always-taker, complier, or never-taker
site_or_time_variables: single fictional tutoring encouragement experiment with one end-of-term outcome
